Erin M: Heads up — noticed a small cluster of users still have org-admin role after last night's KMS rotation + SCIM attr rename.
Samir: which users? any pattern?
Erin M: affected are ~5 users in orgs that had on-prem SSO sync enabled. sample: alice.t, bob_n
Jia Chen: saw something similar in logs. SCIM mapping changed `externalId` -> `ext_id` during deploy; provisioner tolerated both but tombstoned the old key principal which left role bindings referencing the old principal id.
Samir: can you paste the relevant log lines?
Jia Chen: sure — from provisioner logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-18T23:12:01Z provisioner INFO sync start tenant=org-42
2026-03-18T23:12:03Z scim WARN unmapped attr 'externalId' present, mapping -> ext_id
2026-03-18T23:12:04Z kms INFO rotate key=projects/.../keys/rg-42 tombstone-principal=principal:scim:1234
2026-03-18T23:12:05Z provisioner ERROR reconcile failed, orphaned-role-binding principal=principal:scim:1234 role=org-admin
```
Erin M: so tombstone happened before we rewrote role bindings to the new principal id
Samir: sounds like a race between key rotation and role rewrite. Did reconcile job run after rotation?
Jia Chen: reconcile started but skipped principals with tombstone flag. code snip:
```
if principal.tombstoned:
  continue  # legacy safety: avoid reassigning lost principals
```
on the same run we never created mapping from old->new
Erin M: any quick mitigation? don't want users with admin retained
Samir: run a targeted reconcile for those tenants forcing mapping lookup and rebind. I can run a one-off script.
Jia Chen: also we should fix provisioner to queue tombstone handling until role migration completes. and add checksum/check for stale bindings referencing tombstoned principals.
provisioner-bot: [alert] reconcile-job org-42 forced-run by Samir at 2026-03-19T01:05:10Z
Samir: ran forced reconcile, log: `rebind 5 bindings -> new-principals` — appears fixed for org-42. Will run across other tenants with on-prem SSO.
Erin M: created a ticket and added short postmortem checklist in #incidents. Quick TODOs: 1) add gating so rotation defers tombstone until migration success 2) add metric for bindings referencing tombstoned principals 3) backfill script to rebind stale entries
Jia Chen: I'll open a PR for the gating and metric. small patch to `provisioner/sync.go`.
Erin M: thanks. ping me when PRs and backfill are scheduled. :thumbsup:
oncall-ops: FYI I've scheduled a 30m maintenance window in case we need rollback on rotation 03/19 03:00-03:30 UTC
